context.exploration_scope: Operationally validated PHASE-SSI-S18's newly-adopted capability Principle by re-verifying its evidence, freshly reading cap_dataset_management's current state, and applying one real judgment case with the independent verdict computed first

problem: PHASE-SSI-S18 recorded a second Principle as adopted but not enforced -- it had never been applied to a real judgment to see whether the verdict it predicts matches the pre-existing real convention (PHASE-946's own Goal<->Capability layer separation, already on record before this Principle existed) that is independent of the new Principle.

decision.decision_summary: Principle principle_cap_dataset_management_ssi_s18_v1 evidence re-verified: exists=true, real_linked=true. Real judgment case (When a Goal<->Capability inconsistency exists for a goal backed by cap_dataset_management, which layer absorbs the correction?): independent_verdict_computed_first=CAPABILITY_FUNCTIONAL_STATUS_LAYER (from PHASE-946s own pre-existing record), principle_guided_verdict=CAPABILITY_FUNCTIONAL_STATUS_LAYER, match=true. 0 CI wiring, 0 automatic policy, 0 automatic execution. Verdict: PRINCIPLE_GUIDED_DECISION_CONFIRMED.

action.action_summary: Re-verified both evidence records fresh; freshly read cap_dataset_management's current overlay functional_status and trace chain state; computed the independent verdict first from trace v16's own pre-existing capability_status_clarification text (PHASE-946, predating this Principle); computed the Principle-guided verdict from the Principle's own stated logic; compared them.

result.note: The Principle, applied to a real current judgment case, produced the same verdict as the pre-existing independent PHASE-946 convention -- operationally validated, still not CI/policy/execution-wired.

cause.root_cause_summary: A second Principle adopted from a different relationship axis (capability, not goal) has not demonstrated operational correctness just because its evidence re-verifies and its scope is bounded -- it has to be run against a real judgment and checked against an independently-derived verdict, the same discipline the first (goal-scoped) Principle was held to in S5.

lesson: Operational validation generalizes the same way promotion and adoption did: a capability-scoped Principle is checked against a real case using a pre-existing, Principle-independent convention (here, PHASE-946's own already-recorded Goal<->Capability layer separation) exactly as the goal-scoped Principle was checked against PHASE-943's owner_domain convention in S5 -- the specific convention differs, but the discipline of computing the independent answer first does not.
